in_grid[15] = [8]*7 + [1] + [8]*12
in_grid[16] = [8]*6 + [1,1] + [8]*12
in_grid[17] = [8]*5 + [1,1,1,1] + [8]*11

in_grid[19] = [8]*3 + [1]*6 + [8]*10 + [6]
assert all(len(r)==20 for r in in_grid)
out_grid=[row[:] for row in in_grid]
for r in range(20):
    for c in range(20):
        if in_grid[r][c] == 8:
            edge = r in (0,19) or c in (0,19)
            near1 = any(0 <= rr < 20 and 0 <= cc < 20 and in_grid[rr][cc] == 1
                        for rr in range(r-1,r+2) for cc in range(c-1,c+2))
            if edge or near1: out_grid[r][c]=7
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out_grid))
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':out_grid}, separators=(',',':')))
